description: START HERE for a question about PostgreSQL. Searches every mailing list (inbox narrows it) with hybrid keyword + semantic ranking and returns cited passages that fit token_budget (default 4000, max 32000): one passage per thread, each the author's own words (quotes, signature and patch removed, cut at ~1200 chars) with url, inbox, message_id, from and date. found=false with a reason when the archive does not appear to discuss the question, instead of weak matches. Retrieval only: write the answer yourself. Cite each claim with its passage url or https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>; open a thread with get_thread. author, since and until restrict it to what one person wrote in a date window (filter echoes them). The question may carry search operators (after:2020, site:<list>); operators, warnings and skipped report what they did.

author.description: Only messages this person sent: a name, an e-mail address or hash:<8 hex> (a person page). Resolved to every address they post from; an ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from.

inbox.description: Lists to search: omit (or "all") for every list, the default; one name such as pgsql-bugs; or several, comma-separated ("pgsql-hackers,pgsql-bugs"). Names from list_inboxes. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

since.description: Only messages sent on or after this date (UTC): YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago.

token_budget.description: Maximum tokens of evidence to return (default 4000, max 32000).

until.description: Only messages sent before this date (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what that person had said by then.

name: retrieve_context
